title: Pineapple Panna
subtitle: Pineapple cooked with sugar and ginger, ground with saffron into a bright, tangy summer concentrate.
protein: A cooler, not a protein source

method.title: Cook the pineapple
items: Cover and cook on medium until the pineapple turns soft, 15–20 min
Stir once or twice so the sugar doesn't catch at the bottom
Take it off the flame and let it cool

method.label: Toddler — keep her share (before the green chili)
items: Blend {=2 tbsp} of the cooked pineapple with a little of its syrup until smooth; keep it in a small jar
To serve, stir {=1 tbsp} into {=½ cup} of cool water — no masala, no ice

method.title: Grind the panna
items: Transfer the rest of the pineapple to a grinder jar
Refrigerate in a clean jar; it keeps about a week

method.title: Serve
items: In a tall glass, take a spoonful (about {=2 tbsp}) of pineapple panna; add {@lime} and {@ice}

method.label: Tip
method.text: The green chili used to cook with the pineapple; it's now ground in raw at the end, so the toddler's share stays mild. Part of Chef Ranveer Brar's panna trio, with aam panna and guava panna.
